identity: SHA-256 of the delivered bytes. Use the complete artifact set from one build and compare it to the installed package; hashes do not establish behavioral support.

skills.name: en-reve-component
skills.title: Write library components
skills.responsibility: Implementation, reusable layers, definitions and public contracts.
skills.boundary: Application integration belongs to en-reve-consume; workflow orchestration to en-reve-app; theme design to en-reve-theme. Use testing/documentation skills only for the corresponding requested work.

skills.name: en-reve-test
skills.title: Verify functional behavior
skills.responsibility: Functional test authoring, execution and scoped results.
skills.boundary: Accessibility semantics, WCAG and AT review belong to en-reve-accessibility; performance campaigns retain their own protocol. Report product defects; use en-reve-component when implementing an authorized fix.

skills.name: en-reve-accessibility
skills.title: Verify accessibility
skills.responsibility: Semantic ownership, keyboard/focus, accessibility preferences and automated/manual evidence.
skills.boundary: General state-machine and transport tests belong to en-reve-test; component implementation and theme fixes retain their own owners. Accessibility findings do not authorize changes to platform settings or acceptance scope.

skills.name: en-reve-document
skills.title: Document the library
skills.responsibility: User/developer/designer guidance, runnable example presentation, migrations and contract delivery.
skills.boundary: Do not redesign public APIs, implement runtime features, certify accessibility or publish a release as a side effect of documenting them. Route an exposed defect to its owning skill.

skills.name: en-reve-consume
skills.title: Integrate existing components
skills.responsibility: Select and wire existing public component APIs inside an application.
skills.boundary: Whole-application routing, service adapters and workflow state belong to en-reve-app. New library components belong to en-reve-component. Theme design belongs to en-reve-theme. Keep a one-control integration a one-control task.

skills.name: en-reve-app
skills.title: Build application workflows
skills.responsibility: Application-level state, routing, service boundaries, composition and responsive task flow.
skills.boundary: Delegate individual component contracts to en-reve-consume and visual theme rules to en-reve-theme. Do not alter library internals or create a new component merely to deliver an app.

skills.name: en-reve-theme
skills.title: Author themes and scoped style
skills.responsibility: Token relationships, appearance/scoping, group/component properties and candidate theme authoring.
skills.boundary: Runtime behavior belongs to en-reve-component, application architecture to en-reve-app, and acceptance testing to the relevant test skill. A theme edit does not authorize adoption or baseline promotion.
